Real Life Experience Featuring the Trusted Travel Girl [Video]
@graph.transcript:
[NARRATOR]
I’m Valerie Joy Wilson and as a professional traveler…
[NARRATOR]
…I hear a lot of stories when it comes to travel insurance.
[NARRATOR]
But, as a real-life user of Travel Guard for the last eight years…
[NARRATOR]
…it’s definitely who I recommend to use.
[NARRATOR]
I’ve had a lot of unfortunate travel experiences…
[NARRATOR]
…but fortunately…
[NARRATOR]
…they were all covered by Travel Guard.
[NARRATOR]
Travel insurance is so personally important to me.
[NARRATOR]
I was supposed to be on my dream trip in Switzerland skiing the Swiss Alps…
[NARRATOR]
…but instead, my dream trip turned into a nightmare.
[NARRATOR]
I was supposed to be jumping out of helicopter skiing powder that I had always dreamed of skiing my entire life…
[NARRATOR]
…but the universe had other plans in store for me.
[NARRATOR]
Instead, I had appendicitis…
[NARRATOR]
…and had to have my appendix taken out immediately.
[NARRATOR]
Now, imagine this…
[NARRATOR]
…I’m alone in a foreign country…
[NARRATOR]
…jetlagged…
[NARRATOR]
…I just landed…
[NARRATOR]
…and I was told I needed an emergency appendectomy.
[NARRATOR]
Check this out…
[NARRATOR]
…so…
[NARRATOR]
I woke up…
[NARRATOR]
…and then I had a really bad stabbing pain in my stomach and then it stared to move down to my appendix.
[NARRATOR]
I started throwing up…
[NARRATOR]
…I couldn’t move…
[NARRATOR]
…I couldn’t walk…
[NARRATOR]
…I literally was just like completely immobile.
[NARRATOR]
I crawled to the phone, called the front desk at my hotel and asked them to call me an ambulance.
[NARRATOR]
So, while the ambulance was on their way…
[NARRATOR]
…my first thought…
[NARRATOR]
…was actually that I was insured and I knew I didn’t have anything to worry about…
[NARRATOR]
…other than taking care of myself because I had Travel Guard and I knew that they had my back.
